speaker: S25
garrusi: ewse we ewanêş da
english: As you see, he also gave to them.

speaker: S25
garrusi: neferî yê dane we ewanêş da
english: He gave each of them one.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ewse saygey libasegey ki temîzo bû
english: That’s it, (he) rubs it on his shirt to become clean.

speaker: S25
garrusi: keftîvî zemîn newüjîd kesîf bû
english: (So) (you) don’t say (it may) be dirty (because) (it) had fallen on the ground.

speaker: S25
garrusi: her kanîyan neferî yê gazêş den leyo
english: Each one of them also took a bite of it.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ewe dûware hem dekird teqteqege şûrû kird
english: He again took (it) out and started the clacking.

speaker: S25
garrusi: tinîsege dekird
english: (He) took out the tennis (racket).

speaker: S25
garrusi: ewse pîyage benney xoda tazi xewerdar bîye
english: As you see, the poor man has just become aware.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ewse le nerdiwanege’o dîyaye xwar
english: As you see, he comes down from the ladder.

speaker: S25
garrusi: dîyay ewe xalî bikey
english: (He) comes to empty it.

speaker: S25
garrusi: timşa key
english: He looks.

speaker: S25
garrusi: dünî ê! sebedegey yêkiley nîye
english: He sees Wow! One of his baskets is not there.

speaker: S25
garrusi: şumarîgeyan
english: He counts them.

speaker: S25
garrusi: dünî du danes
english: He sees (that) they are two.

speaker: S25
garrusi: bes yêkiley ka?
english: So where is one of them?

speaker: S25
garrusi: te’ecub key
english: He gets surprised.

speaker: S25
garrusi: wey la timşa key
english: (He) looks at this side.

speaker: S25
garrusi: wew la timşa key
english: (He) looks at that side.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ew sê nefer zařû’ege ki meselen çit le desîyane xwen dîyan pîyage timşay ewane key
english: The man looks at them, those three children who, for example, have pears in their hands (and) are eating (as) they are coming.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ewêş ki teqiteq key
english: He is constantly clacking.

speaker: S25
garrusi: pîyagêş timşay ewane key bizanî ewane le kûre hawirdigen ewe xwardigin
english: The man also looks (at) them (to) know from where (they) have brought (and) eaten it.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ewanêş we rîyi xoyan êdami den
english: They also continue their own way.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ewse he le naw çitege’o dořin
english: As you see, they keep going through the mountains.

speaker: S25
garrusi: hêş timsay pîyagêş nekirdin
english: They did not look at the man at all.

speaker: S25
garrusi: ne pîyage le ewane pirsî we kûre dořin ne ewane pirsin to çe keyd
english: Neither the man asks them where are (you) going nor they ask what are you doing here.
